lines: # The finish line of Canyon Dash: run as the runner, only while the clock runs
execute unless score #canyon_dash.clock.on msm_examples.msm_timers matches 1 run return 0
execute unless score @s msm_examples.canyon_dash.best matches 1.. run scoreboard players operation @s msm_examples.canyon_dash.best = #canyon_dash.clock msm_examples.msm_timers

meta.notes: Run when a runner reaches the finish, while the clock runs: stops it and shows the time left, and keeps it in msm_examples.canyon_dash.best when it is more than their best so far.
